name: @telorun/embedding
description: Telo embedding module — Embedding.Model abstract plus Query / Passage invocables that turn text into vectors.
author: Bartosz Pasiński <bartosz.pasinski@codenet.pl>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && esbuild src/passage-controller.ts src/query-controller.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --external:@telorun/sdk --conditions=source --outdir=. --banner:js='import { createRequire as __teloCreateRequire } from "node:module";const require = __teloCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' --out-extension:.js=.mjs
